description: This script automates code generation tasks for the ANGLE project, specifically generating build files and data dependencies for Vulkan conformance test suite (VK-GL-CTS). It manages data directories, path replacements, and creates build and gni files for the test data.

methods.name: initDataDirectories
methods.description: Initializes a list of data directories with specific subpaths for GLES and external data.

methods.name: initPathReplacements
methods.description: Sets up path replacements for external graphicsfuzz and openglcts directories.

methods.name: createBuildGnFile
methods.description: Deletes existing build gn file if present and creates a new writable file.

methods.name: createGniFile
methods.description: Deletes existing gni file if present and creates a new writable file.

methods.name: writeFileHeader
methods.description: Writes a standard header comment to a file, indicating it is generated code.

methods.name: fixDestinationDirectory
methods.description: Replaces parts of a directory path based on path replacements.

methods.name: convertPathToVarName
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path to a variable name by replacing path separators with underscores.

methods.name: getCMakeLists
methods.description: Recursively finds all CMakeLists.txt files within a given directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling argument parsing, data directory initialization, file generation, and data collection for build configuration.
